evidence: M-O s.v. pastry types: cinnamon roll
terms.comment: Cato’s coil-cake: the dough of a placenta, rolled out like a rope and coiled, then spread with honey. Morgan–Owens gives spīra ex cinnamōmō where the cinnamon matters.
Traupman’s pāniculus, a bread roll, with an adjective on cinnamōmum that is not in Lewis & Short (which has cinnameus and cinnamōminus).

phrases.latin: spīram sīc facitō … ita utī placenta fit, eadem omnia facitō, nisi aliō modō fingitō
phrases.english: make a coil-cake like this: … do everything as for a placenta, only shape it differently

sources: Lewis & Short: spira · Lewis & Short: cinnamomum
